summary: Full backend + UI verification of PRO 'Mes chiens' feature and DELETE /api/dogs/{id} fix. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (own-dog create/list/delete for PRO_STANDARD, PRO_AVANCE, PRO_COORDINATEUR, PARTICULIER, plus isolation check that personal dogs do NOT appear in 'Chiens suivis' for PROs). UI: All four profiles show 'Mes chiens' tab, can create a dog via dog-form (dog-name-input + dog-add-button -> dog-card-<id>), delete works via dog-menu-<id> -> dog-delete-<id> -> Confirmer (toast 'Chien supprimé'), empty state 'Aucun chien enregistré' (data-testid dogs-empty) shows for user with no dog. Isolation verified in UI too (personal dogs NOT in /dogs page for PROs).
critical_code_review_comments: dogs.py list_dogs: when owner_id == self, it now scopes to owner_id regardless of role (good). However, a manager (bureau) requesting owner_id=self will only see their own dogs, no longer the global feed - acceptable, matches feature intent.
delete_dog cascade cleanup (journal/cases/steps/reports/comments/owner_notes) is thorough and idempotent - good.
Consider adding a confirmation on backend that DELETE is idempotent (second delete returns 404 via dog_access - already the case).
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_* dogs during flow (cleanup verified via post-delete GET 404). No leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRO personal dogs feature + DELETE /api/dogs/{id} fully verified in iteration 37. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_pro_personal_dogs.py can be re-run as regression. Note: some accounts show an onboarding modal ('Vos premiers pas' or 'Bienvenue') on first login - dismiss with 'Plus tard'/'Ignorer' before interacting with profile tabs.
rca of the issue: N/A - all features work as intended.
